items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I said Everett Thomas C., I said, well, I worked for him when I was a kid.

ctx.x: But, oh, I said Everett Thomas C., I said, well, I worked for him when I was a kid. The old midway, he said, well, that's why I mentioned that. I figured you must have played music there if you were from New Orleans. I said, yes, I did. In fact, I opened the place up. Now, I don't remember just what the relation he was to Everett Thomas C., but he was a relation.
By the way, in the old days, did you travel much, any of the bands you were with, did they get out of New Orleans?
